TaskDescription: After scanning, participants viewed the 50 main-task PHASE videos and categorized the relationship between the two agents.

onset.Description: Time from the beginning of the post-scan behavioral task to video onset.

stimulus_id.Description: Task-specific video identifier, such as 47.mov. The mapping from this identifier to the original PHASE dataset filename is provided in stimuli/phase_stimulus_id_mapping.tsv.

response.Description: Participant's categorization of the relationship between the two agents.

Levels.Friendly: The agents were judged to have a friendly relationship.
Levels.Neutral: The agents were judged to have a neutral relationship.
Levels.Adversarial: The agents were judged to have an adversarial relationship.
Levels.NoResponse: The participant did not respond, or no response was recorded.
Levels.InvalidResponse: A button press was recorded, but the button did not correspond to any of the available response options.

response_time.Description: Time between the response prompt and the participant's response.

button_order.Description: Left-to-right ordering of the relationship response options presented on the trial.
